summary: Initializes an object (vtable install, counter and pointer fields zeroed) then walks an embedded singly-linked list starting at this+0xF8, freeing the payload chain and each node, and finally resets the head/tail pointers, counts and flag bytes to zero. Acts as a combined constructor and cleanup path for a linked-list-backed object. The list node layout (data at +0, next at +4, one-byte flag at +8) is read directly from the raw source.

local_names.head_node: *(this+0xF8), first node of the embedded linked list
local_names.node_data: first word of a list node (payload pointer)
local_names.node_next: second word of a list node (next pointer)
local_names.node_flag: byte at node+8 controlling whether the payload chain is freed

operations.description: Zero the counter/state dwords this[57]..this[60] at offsets 0xE4..0xF0.

Walk the linked list from head this[62] (offset 0xF8), following each node's next pointer at node+4 until a null next terminates the walk; the head node's data and next pointers are read through *(this+0xF8) and *(this+0xFC) respectively.
If the node's one-byte flag at node+8 is set, free the node's payload chain (inner payload pointer then the payload block) via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Free the current list node itself via FreeWrapper_7bcf.

Reset the linked-list container fields to zero: head/tail pointers this[62]..this[63] (0xF8..0xFC), element count this[64] (0x100), capacity this[65] (0x104), unknown field this[66] (0x108), and flag bytes at 0xF4 and 0xF5.

unresolved: The list node layout (payload at +0, next at +4, one-byte flag at +8) is visible only in the raw source text; only the payload and next-of-tail reads have packet field evidence refs.
Semantics of the individual counter fields at 0xE4..0xF0 and the flag bytes at 0xF4/0xF5 are unknown beyond being reset to zero.
